waivers.verdict: Lamar Jackson is officially Out — move him to IR now. It costs nothing and opens your one empty bench spot. Nothing on the wire clears the bar for that spot tonight.

lineup.verdict: No changes. Jackson's Out closes Thursday's close call — Bryce Young stays at SUPER_FLEX. Rest of the lineup holds as set.

trades.verdict: Hold — no offer clears the certainty bar. Jackson turning Out is a reason to IR him (see today's waivers report), not shop him while his value is down.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable yet — Jackson's Out designation is already handled in today's lineup and waivers reports, and the rest of the Week 7 slate doesn't kick off until Sunday.

actions.name: Lamar Jackson
actions.why: Jackson is Out and IR-eligible; moving him frees your last bench slot for free while he's sidelined.
